findings.message: The ticket asked section 4 to drop the word "operator", turn the two operator gates into commands, and add the capture and credential blocks to `roadmap status`. The rewrite also deletes two design facts it had no mandate to touch. One is "Read-only; the extension draws it later.", a constraint on `clutch roadmap status`. The other is the list of existing command gates: "the suite, a `status` query, a `training export` count". The `release-gates-as-commands` ticket is authored from this text, and it would lose both.
findings.paved_road: Restore "Read-only; the extension draws it later." and the examples of prose gates that become commands (the suite, a `status` query, a `training export` count). Change only the clauses that name an operator or a person.

findings.message: The ticket asked B7 to make `./dev.py visual-baseline` report agreement with the AI label panel's labels. The rewrite also drops "The report is committed like the review baseline's." and narrows "the layer-1 score distributions that separate the labels" to "the layer-1 score distributions". That loses the design requirement that the baseline report is committed, which no part of Scope in removes.
findings.paved_road: Keep "The report is committed like the review baseline's." and "that separate the labels" in the B7 `./dev.py visual-baseline` bullet. Change only the source of the labels.
